units.source_text: 后来真木柱夫人从宫中退出，对大纳言谈宫中的情况，便中告诉他说：

en.t: Later, when Lady Makibashira withdrew from the palace, she spoke with the Grand Counselor about affairs there and, in passing, told him:

units.source_text: “前天小公子到宫中值宿，

en.t: The day before yesterday, the young gentleman came to spend the night on duty at the palace,

units.source_text: 次日早上到东宫来，身上香气非常浓重。

en.t: and the next morning, when he came to the Crown Prince's residence, the fragrance about him was extraordinarily strong.

units.source_text: 别人都以为他本来是这样的，皇太子却分辨得出，

en.t: Everyone else thought that was simply how he always smelled, but the Crown Prince could tell the difference,

units.source_text: 对他说道：‘你一定是在匂兵部卿亲王身边，

en.t: and said to him, 'You must have been at Prince Niou Hyobukyo's side,

units.source_text: 怪不得不到我这里来了。’

en.t: so no wonder you did not come to me.'

units.source_text: 他竟吃起醋来，真好笑呢。

en.t: He actually became jealous; it was very amusing.

units.source_text: 他有信带来么？

en.t: Did he bring a letter?

units.source_text: 看不出有什么动静呢。”

en.t: I cannot see that anything is happening."

units.source_text: 红梅大纳言答道：“有信带来的。

en.t: The Grand Counselor Kobai replied, "Yes, he did bring a letter.

units.source_text: 这位皇子喜爱梅花。

en.t: That prince is fond of plum blossoms.

units.source_text: 那边檐前的红梅正好盛开，仅乎自己看看，太可惜了，

en.t: The red plum before the eaves over there is just in full bloom, and it seemed too much of a pity to enjoy it only by myself,

units.source_text: 我就折了一枝，叫他送给这皇子。

en.t: so I broke off a branch and had him send it to the prince.

units.source_text: 此人身上的衣香的确异乎寻常。

en.t: The fragrance clinging to this person's robes is truly out of the ordinary.

units.source_text: 宫女们也没有这么香。

en.t: Even the court ladies do not smell so fragrant.

units.source_text: 还有那源中纳言，并非为爱风流而薰香，身上却自有一股香气，

en.t: And then there is that Minamoto Middle Counselor, who does not perfume himself out of any love of elegance, yet a fragrance naturally rises from his body,

units.source_text: 世无其类。

en.t: with nothing like it in all the world.

units.source_text: 真奇怪，不知前世怎样修福，故今世获此善报，真正教人艳羡。

en.t: It is truly strange; who knows what merit he cultivated in a former life to receive such blessings in this one? It really makes one envious.

units.source_text: 同是称为花的，那梅花因为生来本性与众不同，所以香气特别可爱。

en.t: Among all things called flowers, the plum blossom has a nature unlike the others from birth, and so its fragrance is especially lovely.

units.source_text: 匂皇子喜爱梅花，确是有道理的。”

en.t: There is indeed good reason why Prince Niou loves plum blossoms."

units.source_text: 他拿花作比拟而议论这匂皇子。

en.t: He used flowers as a comparison while speaking about Prince Niou.
